ruleDefinitions.name: New Root Certificate Installed Via CertMgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of "certmgr" with the "add" flag in order to install a new certificate on the system.
Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\CertMgr\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CERTMGT\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*root.*")))
